title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
desc: Mudit, a shy boy, wins Sugandha's heart and plans marriage. But their relationship faces turmoil when they discover his erectile dysfunction, challenging their love before the wedding.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Khoon Bhari Mang
desc: Widowed Aarti is trapped in Sanjay's devious marriage plot. With Nandini's help, he tries to drown her and steal her wealth, but she survives and rises to seek revenge.

title: Attack
desc: After a terror attack leaves Arjun paralysed and grieving his lover, he joins a radical experiment when the attacker resurfaces, seeking revenge and a chance to fight back.

title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
desc: Kannu, an eight-year-old boy, writes to India's prime minister after his mother is raped. With two friends, he journeys from Mumbai to Delhi, bravely seeking justice.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Jawan
desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Sikandar
desc: A young, driven rebel takes on a corrupt system, fighting for ordinary citizens' rights and shaking up the entrenched power structures of an unjust nation.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
desc: In an arranged marriage, failed cricketer Mahendra and doctor Mahima bond over their shared nickname, Mahi, and their love for cricket, inspiring her to pursue her dreams.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
